name: skewforge
description: Self-hosted version skew protection: old tabs keep working after every deploy

scripts.dev: concurrently -n gateway,dashboard -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @skewforge/server" "npm run dev -w @skewforge/dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @skewforge/dashboard && npm run build -w @skewforge/server && npm run build -w @skewforge/cli
